user.title: Set up Antiflap
user.description: Create a binary sensor that resists short inactive/request gaps by holding on longer after repeated short gaps.

data_description.input_entity: Entity to watch while the request should be active. For example: Office Motion.
data_description.active_state: Input entity state that means active. Defaults to `on`.
data_description.free_flaps: How many flaps are ignored before adaptive hold begins. Most users will want to set this to 0.
data_description.flap_gap_seconds: Inactive gaps at or below this duration count as flaps when the input becomes active again.
data_description.base_hold_seconds: The first hold duration after the free flaps are exceeded. Leave blank to use half of flap gap seconds.
data_description.hold_factor: Multiplier used to grow each additional hold duration.
data_description.min_on_seconds: Minimum time the Antiflap sensor must stay on after it turns on. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.window_seconds: How long recent flaps are remembered. Leave blank to use 1.5x maximum hold.

error.active_state_required: Enter the input state that means active.
error.max_less_than_base: Maximum hold seconds must be greater than or equal to base hold seconds.

abort.already_configured: This Antiflap sensor is already configured.
